locations.title: The Archon Main Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**

- First, build the [Pack-A-Punch Machine](#loc=1084860) through the main quest, then interact with the [Stone Pedestal](#loc=1084874) to place down the artifact.
- After a short discussion, a portal will open to the Dark Aether.
- Head inside and survive until Kortifex forces everyone to be downed, then he will teleport everyone back to the Stone Pedestal.
- Next, three trials will need to be completed in any order:
  - Trial of Mindfulness
    - Around the [Obelisk](#loc=1084882) on Merchant Road, dig up the nearby [Dig Spot](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-the-archon?search=dig_spot%20%26%26%20category%3A28626) until a red orb spawns.
    - Follow it, then interact with it to spawn a series of symbols on the wall.
    - Remember the symbols and capture the runes in order of the symbols.
    - Complete this three times, then interact with the Obelisk to start the final trial.
    - Capture the runes on the ground that spawn. Once enough runes have been captures, the trial will complete.
  - Trial of Sacrifice
    - First, light three torches around the Derailment area with a molotov in order:
      1. [Torch](#loc=1084912)
      2. [Torch](#loc=1084913)
      3. [Torch](#loc=1084915)
    - Once the last one is lit, a red orb will spawn.
    - Sacrifice a Pack-A-Punched gun to the red orb and it'll head into the [Obelisk](#loc=1084908) on the train car.
    - Switch to the Ring of Fire Artifact and interact with the Obelisk to start the trial.
    - Kill zombies near the central artifact until a Full Power power-up spawns, then head to one of the outer obelisks that spawned.
    - Use Ring of Fire on the Obelisk and kill zombies while standing inside of the circle to charge the Obelisk.
      - A red line will connect the outer Obelisk to the central Obelisk when fully charged.
    - Repeat until all four Obelisks are connected to the center to complete the trial.
  - Trial of Resilience
    - Head to the Debris Field and destroy the [Ruined Crystals](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-the-archon?search=ruined_crystal%20%26%26%20category%3A28622) until a red orb spawns.
    - Follow the red orb, and three items will need to be collected and brought back to the orb:
      - [Cursed Officer's Hat](#loc=1085003)
      - [Cursed Skull](#loc=1085004)
      - [Cursed Femur](#loc=1085009)
    - Once complete, grab the [Decimator Shield](#loc=1085022) from the ground and interact with the [Obelisk](#loc=1084998) to start the trial.
    - Syphoncores will spawn around the area. Use the Decimator Shield's alternate fire to destroy them, then interact with them to collect the blood.
    - Place the blood in the empty fountain in the Debris Field until the fountain is full, completing the trial.
- Once all trials are completed, the portal will reopen to the Dark Aether. Heading into the portal will start the boss fight against Kortifex.

locations.title: Rampage Inducer Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**

- Shoot the skulls around the spawn Temple in a specific order:  
  1. [Skull](#loc=1085098)
  2. [Skull](#loc=1085099)
  3. [Skull](#loc=1085101)
  4. [Skull](#loc=1085102)
  5. [Skull](#loc=1085103)
- Once all five are shot in order, the [Rampage Inducer](#loc=1085105) will spawn across from the [Pack-A-Punch Machine](#loc=1084860).

locations.title: Mr. Peeks Ray Gun Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**

- With the [Rampage Inducer](#loc=1085105) active after completing the [Rampage Inducer Easter Egg](#loc=1085031), a Mr. Peeks part will spawn in a random [Dig Spot](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-the-archon?search=dig_spot%20%26%26%20category%3A28626) every five rounds.
- After digging up the third Mr. Peeks part, a Ray Gun will drop.

locations.title: Vanishing Shore Song Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**

- Interact with the [Guitar](#loc=1085111) on the second floor of the Radio Outpost three times to play the Vanishing Shore song.

locations.title: Zombie Head Hunting Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**

- After round five, a zombie will be hiding around outside the map.
  - The zombie will show up on the minimap.
  - If approached too closely, the zombies will disappear until next round.
- Depending where it spawns, you will need to shoot it with a specific gun:
  - [Hiding Zombie](#loc=1085194): SMG
  - [Hiding Zombie](#loc=1085196): Assault Rifle
  - [Hiding Zombie](#loc=1085159): Shotgun
- Depending on which gun is required, when shot, you will be brought into a special trial:
  - Both trials require shooting a floating head until it is destroyed
    - SMG/Assault Rifle: 
      - Shoot the blue orbs that the head spawns. If too many build up, the trial will fail.
      - Don't shoot the red orbs that the head spawns. If shot, the trial will fail.
    - Shotgun:
      - Shoot the floating head only when it's not red. If shot while red, the trial will fail.
- If successfully completed, the head will reward you with 2,500 essence, a max ammo, and a chest with a Pack-A-Punched gun.
